security_spec.violation_condition: When pdisadr2 is written with a physical or guest-physical address without right-shifting by 2 bits (i.e., storing the full address instead of addr[63:2] concatenated with the low 2 bits implied by the virtual address), the hardware violates the spec requirement that physical addresses in pdisadr2 use the same shift-by-2 encoding as PMP address registers and page table entries.
security_spec.summary: Physical/guest-physical addresses stored to pdisadr2 must be right-shifted by 2 bits (PMP-style encoding) to accommodate addresses wider than XLEN; missing this shift causes all reported physical addresses to be off by factor of 4, leaking incorrect memory layout to untrusted consumers of profiling data

findings.finding: pdisadr2 register does not exist in the XiangShan RTL codebase. Exhaustive search across all tracked Scala/Chisel source files using patterns: pdisadr2, pdisadr, PDISadr, pdis.*adr, SampleData.*Adr, adr2 — returned zero RTL results. The only match was an SVG architecture diagram (images/xs-arch-kunminghu.svg), which is not executable RTL. This security spec violation check is not applicable to this project.
findings.snippet: N/A — register not found in codebase
